notes.title: +23 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS
notes.content:
Hello, now is the 9th day since the game release !
And I happy to write the first announcement of an upcoming update. 

[h1]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]
Since this is the most common request from players, 
I can't wait to add it into the game. 

Now I am actively working to deliver the update faster ːsteamthisː

For the first update, new 23 achievements will be possible to complete on the next week. 
[h1]DESCRIPTION[/h1]
[list]
[*] Find 1/3/9 crystals in story modes
[*] Unlock 3/5 chapters
[*] Finish X challenges
[*] Collect 3/6/12 glove skins
[*] Kill 100/500/1000 enemies in total
[*] Eliminations of the concrete enemy
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the game !
Will be happy to keep the discussion active and add new actually wanted achievements in the future, very very soon updates

notes.title: VIDEO GUIDE ABOUT GAME MECHANICS
notes.content:
[b]Hellfire Rampage VR[/b] is different then other games. 
There are many unique mechanics and we will touch some of them.

Check the video guide :
[previewyoutube=cJATXqcoKwo;full][/previewyoutube] 

Text version of the guide:
[b][ABILITY][/b]
The game's key mechanic is your ability to control the time and space.

Your primary ability is a time slow.
It has an unlimited amount of activations and a tiny cooldown.
So, you can spam the ability every time.

If you are moving in some direction and click the ability button,
Your character performs a dash.

Dash is very useful to escape from critical situations.

Use it for dodging enemy's attacks
And for attacking yourself.

Also, it is useable for overcoming traps.

[b][WEAPONS][/b]
Weapons arsenal is wide and rich.
Pick different combinations according to the game situation and available loot.

Shooting guns could be different, but they have ammo limits.
The ammo box restores your magazine to full.

Gun quality could be different :
Common, Harded, Epic and Gold.

Rarity affects bullets type, damage, shooting speed and could activate a scope.
Sometimes it applies a debuff effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036226/694de9e920fe37725c3ceacf34796d3948f421cb.png[/img]

Melee weapons like the shooting, could be one-handed and double-handed.
They have no rarity.

Use melee to [b]reflect any kind of bullets[/b], it is very important for your defense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036226/ae9c6029b7eb24b6651e98a0a57349ebeec3b40e.png[/img]

The damage amount depends on attack speed.
A faster hand move = more damage.

There are Yellow, Orange, and Red states of attack.
Yellow does half of damage, because it is a slow and light.
Orange does full damage as well.
The red one multiplies your damage twice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036226/659b7860ea1812d76f7129803edd5994ce59c46a.png[/img]

[b][DEBUFFS][/b]
There are different debuff effects in the game.
You should attentively distribute them for most dangerous enemies,
to make them an easy target for you.

Freeze - make enemies' animations slower with each stack applied.
Burn - does periodic damage to a target.
Shock - Stuns enemies for a second.
Weaker - Scales enemy size to make him small and weak.

[LEVELS]
The game levels are separated by a chapters.
Each chapter has a Story challenge.
It is a dungeon where your primary mission is to find and return a crystal essence.
When you finish the story adventure it unlocks all challenges in the chapter.

Challenges are special missions, their duration is around 3 minutes.
You will have a specific weapon and chosen enemies.
Your primary mission is to stay alive during the challenge and eliminate the target amount of enemies.

Each successfully finished challenge gives you raid points to unlock new chapters and sometimes it unlocks a gloves skin.

Use this knowledge for your future challenges.
But keep it a secret, because infernals are smart.

Now you are ready for a fight, go on!

notes.title: Beta playtest announcement
notes.content:
Hello folks!

The game is moving toward release as well, but it is one big event before it. 

Steam Next Fest event is scheduled for next dates :
Starts: 14 Oct @ 10:00am Pacific
Ends: 21 Oct @ 10:00am Pacific

The great news is that the HELLFIRE RAMPAGE VR going to participate in it!

Each game at the event needs to share a DEMO version of the game for everyone interested in.

If you are interested and want to help with the game testing, join the playtest now!
The button will appear on the store page.

You will be able to test the demo and affect the game improvements!
